IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: EDUCATING, INSPIRING, & NURTURING GIRLS & BOYS IN THE TRADITION OF QUAKER LEARNING.
IRS990.MissionDesc: AT SAN FRANCISCO FRIENDS SCHOOL, STUDENTS LEARN IN A COMMUNITY GROUNDED IN THE QUAKER VALUES OF REFLECTION, INTEGRITY, PEACEFUL PROBLEM-SOLVING AND STEWARDSHIP. OUR TEACHERS CHALLENGE STUDENTS WITH A DYNAMIC CURRICULUM THAT INSPIRES CURIOSITY, COOPERATION AND HARD WORK. WE TEACH CHILDREN TO LISTEN TO ALL VOICES AND TO TRUST THEIR OWN. WE ENGAGE WITH THE WORLD AROUND US WITH KINDNESS AND CONVICTION, WORKING TOWARD THE QUAKER IDEAL OF A CARING AND JUST SOCIETY.
IRS990.Desc: LOCATED IN SAN FRANCISCO'S MISSION NEIGHBORHOOD, WE ARE AN INDEPENDENT K-8 SCHOOL OFFERING AN OUTSTANDING ACADEMIC EDUCATION THAT INTEGRATES THE QUAKER VALUES OF SIMPLICITY, INTEGRITY, MUTUAL RESPECT, SERVICE TO OTHERS AND PEACEFUL PROBLEM SOLVING. SAN FRANCISCO FRIENDS SCHOOL BLENDS AN ACADEMICALLY CHALLENGING PROGRAM WITH CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT THROUGH HUMAN-CENTERED, INQUIRY-DRIVEN LEARNING. PROGRAM EXPENSES FOR THE CURRENT YEAR WERE PRIMARILY USED TO PROVIDE EDUCATION TO 442 STUDENTS IN KINDERGARTEN THROUGH EIGHTH GRADE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE MOST VALUED PRINCIPLES OF QUAKER EDUCATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL'S ENDOWMENT CONSISTS OF TWO FUNDS ESTABLISHED TO FURTHER THE MISSION AND VISION OF THE SCHOOL.

THE SCHOOL IS A QUALIFIED ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAXES AND STATE FRANCHISE TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND SECTION 23701D OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE, RESPECTIVELY. ACCORDINGLY, THE SCHOOL IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND CALIFORNIA INCOME TAXES AND IS NOT LIABLE FOR FEDERAL UNEMPLOYMENT TAXES. U.S. GAAP REQUIRES MANAGEMENT TO EVALUATE THE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN AND RECOGNIZE A TAX LIABILITY (OR ASSET) IF THE SCHOOL HAS TAKEN AN UNCERTAIN POSITION THAT MORE-LIKELY-THAN-NOT WOULD NOT BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY TAXING AUTHORITIES. MANAGEMENT EVALUATED THE SCHOOL'S TAX POSITIONS AND CONCLUDED THAT IT MAINTAINED ITS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS AND HAD TAKEN NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT WOULD REQUIRE ADJUSTMENT TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THEREFORE, NO PROVISION OR LIABILITY FOR UNKNOWN INCOME TAXES HAS BEEN INCLUDED IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THE SCHOOL'S TAX RETURNS ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY FEDERAL AND STATE TAXING AUTHORITIES. HOWEVER, THERE ARE NO EXAMINATIONS IN PROGRESS NOR ARE THERE ANY PENDING.

SCHOOL RECEIVED $156,392 WHICH IS A PART OF THE GRANT FROM CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO FOR HORIZONS PROGRAM. HORIZONS PROGRAM IS A TRANSFORMATIVE SUMMER PROGRAM FOR UNDERSERVED K-8 PUBLIC SCHOOL STUDENTS.

THE SCHOOL AWARDS TUITION ASSISTANCE DISCOUNTS TO 29% OF ITS STUDENT BODY. THESE ARE IN THE FORM OF TUITION DISCOUNTS. AWARD RECIPIENTS APPLY EACH YEAR AND ARE VETTED THROUGH A RIGOROUS SELECTION PROCESS THAT EVALUATES ELIGIBILITY BASED ON CRITERIA ESTABLISHED BY THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS. IN ADDITION, ALL APPLICANTS MUST SUPPLY TAX DOCUMENTATION AND HOUSEHOLD EXPENDITURE SCHEDULES AS PART OF THE APPLICATION PROCESS. APPLICANTS ARE AWARDED TUITION ASSISTANCE IN THE CONTEXT OF THEIR ELIGIBILITY WITHIN THE PARAMETERS OF THE CRITERIA MENTIONED ABOVE AND WITHIN THE SCOPE OF THE SCHOOL'S BUDGET ALLOCATION FOR THE YEAR. ALL RECIPIENTS RECEIVE AN ENROLLMENT CONTRACT THAT OUTLINES GROSS TUITION AND THE DISCOUNTED AMOUNT DUE. THEY SIGN THE ENROLLMENT CONTRACT ACKNOWLEDGING THE NET AMOUNT DUE AFTER ALL DISCOUNTS ARE APPLIED.

THE SCHOOL PROVIDES A DISCRETIONARY SPENDING BUDGET TO THE HEAD OF THE SCHOOL IN THE AMOUNT OF APPROXIMATELY $2,613 ANNUALLY. IN ADDITION, THE SCHOOL ALSO PROVIDES A HOUSING ALLOWANCE ANNUALLY OF $125,454.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS PREPARED BY THE ORGANIZATION'S ACCOUNTING FIRM AND REVIEWED BY MANAGEMENT PRIOR TO SUBMISSION TO THE SCHOOL'S FINANCE COMMITTEE. THE FINANCE COMMITTEE REVIEWS THE FORM 990 BEFORE FILING AND REPORTS TO THE BOARD THAT THE RETURN HAS BEEN REVIEWED AND APPROVED. A REDACTED COPY OF THE FORM 990, WITH SCHEDULE B DONOR NAMES AND ADDRESSES REMOVED, IS MADE AVAILABLE TO THE BOARD FOR AT LEAST FIVE DAYS PRIOR TO FILING. ADDITIONALLY, A PUBLIC DISCLOSURE COPY OF THE FORM 990 IS AVAILABLE FROM THE CHIEF FINANCIAL & OPERATIONS OFFICER FOR ANYONE WHO WISHES TO REVIEW IT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SAN FRANCISCO FRIENDS SCHOOL ("SFFS") REQUIRES ALL MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES AND KEY EMPLOYEES TO ACT IN THE BEST INTERESTS OF THE SCHOOL AND TO DISCLOSE ANY ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST, INCLUDING FINANCIAL INTERESTS OR RELATIONSHIPS THAT COULD CREATE, OR APPEAR TO CREATE, A CONFLICT BETWEEN THEIR OBLIGATIONS TO THE SCHOOL AND THEIR PERSONAL, BUSINESS, OR OTHER INTERESTS. ALL ACTUAL AND POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTERESTS SHALL BE DISCLOSED BY BOARD MEMBERS TO THE SFFS EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE WHENEVER A CONFLICT ARISES. THE DISINTERESTED MEMBERS OF THE SFFS EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL MAKE A DETERMINATION AS TO WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS AND WHAT SUBSEQUENT ACTION IS APPROPRIATE (IF ANY). THE SFFS EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL INFORM THE BOARD OF SUCH DETERMINATION AND ACTION. THE BOARD SHALL RETAIN THE RIGHT TO MODIFY OR REVERSE SUCH DETERMINATION AND ACTION, AND SHALL RETAIN THE ULTIMATE ENFORCEMENT AUTHORITY WITH RESPECT TO THE INTERPRETATION AND APPLICATION OF THIS POLICY. ON AN ANNUAL BASIS, ALL BOARD MEMBERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES RECEIVE A COPY OF THE SCHOOL'S CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND ARE REQUIRED TO COMPLETE AND SIGN A DISCLOSURE FORM CONFIRMING COMPLIANCE, PROMPTLY REPORTING IN WRITING ANY ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PROCESS FOR DETERMINING COMPENSATION OF THE SCHOOL'S HEAD OF SCHOOL (THE ORGANIZATION'S TOP MANAGEMENT OFFICIAL) IS BEGUN BY KEY MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES SEVERAL MONTH PRIOR TO THE EXPIRATION OF THE HEAD OF SCHOOL'S CONTRACT. THE BOARD MEMBERS WILL SOLICIT DATA FROM THE SCHOOL'S CHIEF FINANCE AND OPERATIONS OFFICER. THE DATA IS GATHERED FROM THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS, WHICH MANAGES THE LARGEST AND MOST UP-TO-DATE DATABASE ON PRIVATE SCHOOL COMPENSATION FOR HEADS OF SCHOOL. THIS DATA IS LOOKED AT BOTH IN TERMS OF NATIONAL, REGIONAL AND LOCAL AVERAGES. THESE DATA AND THE SCHOOL'S RECOMENDATION FOR A COMPENSATION PACKAGE ARE REVIEWED AND VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY BY A COMPENSATION CONSULTANT HIRED BY THE SCHOOL TO LOOK AT THE HEAD'S TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE COMPARED TO OTHER INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS WITH WHOM THE CONSULTANT HAS WORKED, AND WHO, MOST RECENTLY, DELIVERS A REPORT TO THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES SHOWING STATISTICAL INDICATORS RELATING TO COMPENSATION FOR SCHOOL HEADS. THE PROCESS FOR DETERMINING COMPENSATION FOR THE SCHOOL'S OTHER KEY EMPLOYEES IS INITITATED BY THE HEAD OF SCHOOL, WHO REVIEWS NATIONAL, REGIONAL AND LOCAL DATA FOR SIMILAR POSITIONS IN SIMILAR SCHOOLS (INDEPENDENT ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS, ENROLLMENTS APPROXIMATELY 300-500). THIS DATA IS PROVIDED TO THE SCHOOL BY THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS, THE CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS, AND THE INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS BUSINESS OFFICERS ASSOCIATION OF CALIFORNIA, ALL OF WHICH COLLECT THIS DATA ANNUALLY. THE HEAD OF SCHOOL DETERMINES THE KEY EMPLOYEES' COMPENSATION BASED ON COMPARING THESE DATA, THE KEY EMPLOYEE'S LEVEL OF EXPERIENCE, AND PRIOR PERFORMANCE IN THE JOB.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL'S AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE RELEASED TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST. THE SCHOOL'S FORM 990 IS POSTED INDEPENDENTLY ON WWW.GUIDESTAR.ORG. THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY FOR BOARD MEMBERS IS DISTRIBUTED ANNUALY TO ALL BOARD MEMBERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES, AND THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY FOR EMPLOYEES IS PUBLISHED IN THE SCHOOL'S PERSONNEL MANUAL.
